description: Estonian Topographic Database (ETAK) core data, thematic dataset "Transportation" for entire Estonia, layer E_503_siht_j: a division line between forest compartments. Layer naming: "_p" means point geometry, "_j" line geometry, "_a" polygon geometry and "_ka" polygon geometry on top of the "_a" layers. Downloadable files are updated weekly.
